summary: Second attempt at T37. The complete T27 verification matrix plus the two additional checks required by this dispatch were re-run independently on the current working tree: 18 checks, 17 PASS, 1 WARN (the advisory keryx health adapter, exit 0, score 93, 7 P2 complexity findings, no P0/P1), 0 FAIL. Gate verdict: PASS. The workspace suite was executed three times and was green all three times (exit 0, 114 tests, apps/cli 13 files / 69 tests each run); two further complete unfiltered executions (pnpm --filter @echolet/cli test and test:e2e) were also green, giving 5 clean executions and 15/15 clean end-to-end iterations with no file or path exclusions of any kind. keryx test run --strict is back to PASS/exit 0 (it was FAIL/exit 1 in attempt 1). The F-013 class is CLOSED: an independent probe of the built dist/cli.js shows a dash-leading --to reaching the trust layer (exit 3 CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED, identical to the non-dash control), --with reaching history (exit 0), --text carried as content, and --relay-url reaching the configuration validator (exit 2 INVALID_CONFIGURATION) rather than the argument parser; meanwhile unknown flag, missing value at end of argv, repeated option, stray positional, operand after '--' and unknown command all still fail closed with exit 2 INVALID_ARGUMENTS, and a bare trailing '--' remains a no-op, each emitting exactly one JSON object on stdout. The sixteen tests in apps/cli/src/commands/cli.dashOptionValues.test.ts pass unmodified, 16/16 standalone and inside every full run; the file's hash was verified before and after. Test integrity: 38 hashed test files re-verified with 38 OK / 0 FAILED; zero skip/only/todo/t.Skip matches workspace-wide. Test count reconciliation against the T27 baseline of 82: now 114 (+32), entirely in apps/cli (37 to 69) with the other six packages unchanged at 45; the +32 is 31 tests in six new files plus one added case in inbound.test.ts, and no pre-existing test was weakened, skipped or deleted. All ten required measurements from metrics-and-validation.md meet their thresholds, including 0 known-plaintext-marker occurrences, 1 of 20 concurrent claim winners under -race, byte-identical sender restart retry and 0 duplicate receiver history entries. The T36 harness fix holds: dist/cli.js is built exactly once per vitest run by globalSetup, only two build sites exist, and neither the INVALID_ARGUMENTS build race nor its symptom recurred. No source, test, configuration or dependency file was modified. Limitations: local technical-prototype behaviour on one macOS arm64 machine only; no claim of production security, mobile delivery, deployment readiness, external audit completion or user demand.
